name: services/news/articles
description: Retrieve multiple articles by their IDs.
brief_description: Retrieve multiple articles by their IDs.

arguments.name: article_ids
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of article IDs to be retrieved.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section of article method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary that will map your article_ids to article objects, as defined in the aricle method.

If the article cannot be found, or you don't have access to it, then the ID you have supplied will still be present in this response, but the value mapped to it will be null (instead of an object).
